package capacityforecast

// ACR CHAOS-12607 differential oracle harness. acr's
// TestCompletionBinsAgreeWithOpsBinsToModel copies this file into an ops
// checkout's internal/queryapi/capacityforecast package, runs it, and removes
// it. It EXECUTES ops' own binsToModel and histogramFromUint16 on the cases
// acr wrote, so acr's copy is compared with the production function itself,
// never with a digest of its source.
//
// Every field of every served bin is emitted by reflection over ops'
// model.CapacityDistributionBin, so a field ops adds reaches acr's comparison
// and fails it until acr accounts for it. Every leaf is {"t": type, "v":
// string}: no bare JSON number reaches a decode step.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-ops/internal/jobs/metrics/numerical"
)

type acrOracleCase struct {
	Name   string   `json:"name"`
	Values []string `json:"values"`
	Counts []string `json:"counts"`
}

type acrOracleLeaf struct {
	T string `json:"t"`
	V string `json:"v"`
}

type acrOracleResult struct {
	Name       string                     `json:"name"`
	Nil        bool                       `json:"nil"`
	Bins       []map[string]acrOracleLeaf `json:"bins"`
	Unfinished acrOracleLeaf              `json:"unfinished"`
	Horizon    acrOracleLeaf              `json:"horizon"`
}

func acrOracleUints[T uint16 | uint32](t *testing.T, raw []string, bits int) []T {
	t.Helper()
	if raw == nil {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]T, 0, len(raw))
	for _, text := range raw {
		value, err := strconv.ParseUint(text, 10, bits)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("case value %q: %v", text, err)
		}
		out = append(out, T(value))
	}
	return out
}

func acrOracleLeafOf(t *testing.T, value reflect.Value) acrOracleLeaf {
	t.Helper()
	switch value.Kind() {
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int64, reflect.Int32:
		return acrOracleLeaf{T: "int", V: strconv.FormatInt(value.Int(), 10)}
	case reflect.Float64:
		return acrOracleLeaf{T: "float64_bits", V: strconv.FormatUint(math.Float64bits(value.Float()), 16)}
	default:
		t.Fatalf("bin field of kind %s has no oracle encoding: extend the harness and acr's comparison together", value.Kind())
		return acrOracleLeaf{}
	}
}

func TestACRForecastOracle(t *testing.T) {
	in, out := os.Getenv("ACR_FORECAST_ORACLE_CASES"), os.Getenv("ACR_FORECAST_ORACLE_OUT")
	if in == "" || out == "" {
		t.Fatal("ACR_FORECAST_ORACLE_CASES and ACR_FORECAST_ORACLE_OUT are required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []acrOracleCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	results := make([]acrOracleResult, 0, len(cases))
	for _, c := range cases {
		histogram := histogramFromUint16(acrOracleUints[uint16](t, c.Values, 16), acrOracleUints[uint32](t, c.Counts, 32))
		bins, unfinished := binsToModel(histogram, numerical.ForecastHorizonDays)
		result := acrOracleResult{
			Name: c.Name, Nil: bins == nil,
			Unfinished: acrOracleLeaf{T: "int", V: strconv.Itoa(unfinished)},
			Horizon:    acrOracleLeaf{T: "int", V: strconv.Itoa(numerical.ForecastHorizonDays)},
		}
		for _, bin := range bins {
			value := reflect.ValueOf(bin)
			fields := map[string]acrOracleLeaf{}
			for index := 0; index < value.NumField(); index++ {
				fields[value.Type().Field(index).Name] = acrOracleLeafOf(t, value.Field(index))
			}
			result.Bins = append(result.Bins, fields)
		}
		results = append(results, result)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(results)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, encoded, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("acr forecast oracle: %d cases\n", len(results))
}
